messages.content: {"prompt":"A Studio Ghibli-style illustration of a young man standing against a dark urban backdrop. The scene should have a soft, hand-painted look with warm lighting and subtle details. The character should wear a dark green shirt, blue jeans, and sneakers, with expressive, anime-like facial features.","size":"1024x1024"}

{"prompt":"A hand-drawn anime-style illustration of a fit and slim young man standing casually against a charcoal gray wall at nighttime. He wears a stylish olive-green rolled-up shirt, fitted blue jeans, and sleek gray sneakers. His confident posture, friendly expression, and soft shading enhance the warm, approachable atmosphere. The background lighting and painterly textures create a gentle, peaceful setting.","size":"1024x1536"}
